The Sales Associate is responsible for providing all Marine Corps Exchange (MCX) customers with world class customer service with an additional emphasis on courtesy.

Sales associates are the primary service providers and will assist customers in every aspect of the retail business in a friendly, professional, and proactive manner that supports continued customer loyalty.

Sales associates assist their customers in challenging scenarios by using an ¿I can do that¿ mindset, to make all attempts for a positive customer experience and outcomes, before asking for support from the next level mentor or supervisor.

Sales associates are brand and customer program ambassadors for all Marine Corps and MCX programs, including but not limited to, Military Star, Super Star Student, customer satisfaction surveys and Keep it New.

This position can be scheduled throughout the facility, based on the needs of the business including but not limited to, cashier or self-checkout attendant, customer service, salesfloor / department support, stockroom / backroom, and military clothing.

In addition to working indoors, associates may be required to work outdoors or inside coolers and/or chillers. Limited time durations and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided when working inside coolers and/or chillers.

Sales associates who are regularly scheduled in areas are expected to learn basic product knowledge to support customer satisfaction and service.

Sales associates perform store operations tasks such as but not limited to, customer and register transactions, Planogram revisions and setups, identifying missing products, replenish sales floor and coolers, setting promotional signage, visual merchandising, maintaining backroom standards through the 5S program and other operational tasks.

Light housekeeping tasks such as but not limited to, sweeping, dusting and trash removal may be part of daily assigned duties. Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

Assists in preparing and participates in year-end inventory and preparation. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. May require additional training or certifications as required by the business and/or normal working assignments, including but not limited to, food safety training and fuel.

Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all team members through positive conversations and driving customer satisfaction in a teams win environment. Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned.

This is a mixed position where the associate must be able to lift and carry objects up to 45 lbs. independently and objects over 45 lbs. with assistance. FOR POSITIONS AT GAS STATIONS ONLY: May assist with regular fuel lane maintenance including the handling and cleanup of hazardous materials or substances. Must wear appropriate PPE when required.

Must pass and maintain current fuel safety training as required.
At least 1 year experience working in a customer and sales-focused environment is preferred. Cash handling, basic math and register experience strongly preferred. Ability to read and understand operating standards and procedures for service, service recovery, sales and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly. Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals. Attention to detail is required.

About the Role As an SDR, you will be the first point of contact with potential customers. You’ll be part of our team working closely with the Sales & Marketing team, receiving hands-on training, mentorship, and the tools you need to succeed from the local Manager and Montreal HQ.

Fluent in English (other languages are a plus) Passion for technology, communication and building relationships Comfortable working with CRM tools, outreach software, and email/phone contact. Self-motivated, organized and eager to learn Tasks Research target accounts and identify key contacts.

Call, email, and message leads generated via webinars, trade shows, website visitors, and marketing campaigns. Book qualified meetings and keep CRM up to date. Support sales and marketing teams with customer feedback, satisfaction calls, and occasional surveys.

On-the-job training and coaching. 100% remote flexibility - work from anywhere in Poland or Romania Work-life balance: Monday to Friday schedule - no weekends required Growth; career path toward Account Executive or Business Development.

Retail Inside Sales Team Lead is responsible for leading, coaching, and developing a team of Reverse Mortgage Loan Officers within a national consumer-direct sales environment. This role serves as the primary leader for a team of approximately 8–12 Loan Officers, with team size varying based on business needs and organizational growth.

The Team Lead is accountable for driving sales performance, improving conversion metrics, ensuring compliance adherence, and fostering a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer-focused service.

Through data-driven coaching, performance management, and operational partnership, the Team Lead works to maximize production while supporting employee development and organizational goals.

This position is ideal for an experienced reverse mortgage sales leader who thrives in a performance-based environment and possesses a passion for coaching, motivating, and developing top-performing sales professionals. Sales Leadership and Production
Drive team performance through consistent coaching, accountability, and sales leadership.
Lead sales discussions, brainstorming sessions, and best-practice sharing to improve individual and team performance.
Promote a results-oriented culture focused on achieving and exceeding sales objectives.
Monitor and improve lead conversion rates throughout the sales process.
Coach Loan Officers on effective borrower engagement, referral development, relationship-building, and consultative sales techniques.
Provide leadership support for unique borrower situations, escalations, and compliance-sensitive transactions when needed.
No personal loan production is expected
Coaching and Talent Development
Conduct ongoing call reviews and coaching sessions to identify strengths, opportunities, and areas for improvement.
Deliver daily and weekly coaching designed to improve sales effectiveness, conversion rates, and customer experience.
Provide individualized development plans for Loan Officers at varying stages of performance.
Facilitate best-practice sharing across the team to promote continuous learning and collaboration.
Partner with the Training Department to support onboarding efforts and reinforce role-specific knowledge and application of training concepts for new hires.
Performance Management
Monitor individual and team performance metrics on an ongoing basis.
Utilize data and performance trends to diagnose performance gaps and implement corrective action plans.
Conduct performance discussions, coaching conversations, and documentation as necessary.
Manage watchlists, performance improvement plans (PIPs), and disciplinary coaching processes in accordance with company policies.
Support recruiting, interviewing, and selection efforts to maintain appropriate staffing levels.
Compliance and Quality Assurance
Ensure adherence to all federal, state, investor, company, licensing, and regulatory requirements applicable to reverse mortgage lending.
Promote a culture of compliance and ethical sales practices.
Monitor quality assurance results and implement coaching strategies to address identified deficiencies.
Ensure Loan Officers properly follow established workflows, CRM requirements, call cadence expectations, lead management standards, and documentation procedures.
Maintain knowledge of industry regulations, compliance updates, and company policies.
Assist in the investigation and resolution of escalated borrower complaints, executive escalations, regulatory inquiries, and CFPB-related concerns.
May assume direct communication responsibilities with borrowers when appropriate to support complaint resolution or compliance obligations.
Pipeline and Operational Partnership
Partner closely with Processing, Operations, Underwriting, Closing, and other internal departments to facilitate efficient loan progression.
Assist with pipeline oversight and milestone management to identify and remove obstacles affecting production.
Resolve borrower, operational, and process-related escalations impacting customer experience or loan progress.
Serve as a liaison between Sales and Operations to improve communication, efficiency, and borrower outcomes.
Support company initiatives focused on workflow optimization and customer service excellence.
Reporting and Analytics
Prepare and publish daily, weekly, and monthly performance reporting to team.
Analyze sales conversions, funnel metrics, contact rates, pull-through rates, and funding performance.
Utilize data to identify trends, diagnose performance opportunities, and implement action plans.
Leverage business intelligence tools and CRM reporting to support decision-making and performance management.

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. We ship AWS modernization to production in weeks, data platforms migrated, legacy applications and databases refactored, AI agents running against real data, for mid-market and lower-enterprise companies in financial services, healthcare and life sciences, internet and software, manufacturing, and TMEGS.
Our delivery model is built around AI agents that absorb the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, schema mapping, validation, test generation, cutover rehearsal, that traditional consulting bills against human hours. Forward-deployed engineers work on top of those agents, embedded with the customer's team, owning architecture, judgment, and cutover. We commit to a fixed delivery date on a fixed fee. If we slip for reasons inside our control, the cost sits with us.
Most modernization doesn't ship. Ours does. That is the entire pitch.
You'll be the named Mactores contact for AWS sales teams across US territories. AWS account managers, ISMs, partner-development managers, and specialist sellers each carry a partner deck full of firms that all say roughly the same thing. Your job is to make them see Mactores as the agent-native firm in that mix, the one they route to when their customer needs a modernization program finished, not staffed.
What you'll sell maps directly to what AWS reps care about: we're MAP-eligible, AWS Agentic AI Specialized, and predictable on fixed-date engagements. Our founders built the agent platform we deploy, so deployment depth is a structural advantage and AWS reps make money when we win. The conversation starts on the same side of the table.
You won't run deep technical demos, a forward-deployed engineer does that. You set up the meeting, frame the customer's problem, walk through the agent-native approach in business terms, anchor everything in shipped case studies, and hand off to the FDE when the conversation reaches architecture. Then you close the loop: register the opportunity, keep the AWS rep informed, push the deal forward.
This is not a script-and-cadence BDR seat. AWS reps see hundreds of partner BDRs. The ones who get traction can hold a real conversation about the customer's modernization problem, not run through a sequence.

Build coverage across AWS US sales territories: account managers, ISMs, partner-development managers, and specialist sellers (Data, AI/ML, Modernization).
Reach out, follow up, show up at AWS Summits and regional partner events, and build named relationships.
Walk AWS reps through what agent-native AWS modernization means in practice and why it's different from what every other partner in their deck says.
Anchor every conversation in shipped Mactores case studies: named customer, named baseline, named outcome, time-to-value, cost reduction.
Identify customer fit, frame the business problem, articulate Mactores' business value, and tee up the technical demo.
Hand off to the forward-deployed engineer for the architecture walkthrough. Your job is to make sure the FDE walks into a qualified room.
Source Amazon-originated opportunities into the Mactores pipeline, register them in ACE, and keep the AWS rep in the loop through cycle close.
Feed market signal back to Mactores leadership, what AWS reps hear from customers, where the partner conversation is shifting, and which messaging lands.

3–5 years in a BDR, SDR, or partner-development role, with a demonstrated ability to source qualified pipeline from a cold start.
Comfort talking to AWS field teams. Prior work at an AWS partner, exposure to AWS Partner Central, ACE, or MAP, and time on the floor at AWS Summits or re:Invent are preferred, not required but they shorten the ramp.
Comfort with the technical concepts of cloud modernization, data platforms, and agentic AI without being the engineer in the room. You can read an architecture diagram, talk through a case study, and name where the customer's pain is. You don't need to debug a Lambda.
Sharp business-value articulation: you can take a messy customer problem statement, restate it in two sentences, and show how Mactores ships against it.
A self-managed work style. Remote role, distributed AWS field, no daily stand-up babysitting your activity.
Travel roughly 30% across the US AWS offices, customer sites, AWS Summits, re:Invent, and regional partner events.
How we work?
We're not selling a roadmap. Our agents run in production today, and our forward-deployed engineers ship with them every day. Mactores is MAP-eligible, AWS Agentic AI Specialized, and holds seven AWS Consulting Competencies and seventeen Service Validations, the credentials that make an AWS rep's routing decision easy.
The agent-native category window is 6–12 months. After that, "agent-native" becomes commodity vocabulary the way "cloud-native" did. We're on the early side of that window, and the BDR who plants the flag in AWS field conversations now will own those relationships when the category gets loud. You'll join an existing partnership and sales motion, the system works. Your job is to add territory coverage and AWS-originated pipeline to it, not invent the function from scratch.
How you'll be measured
A combination of net-new logos and AWS-originated revenue. Not call counts, not email volume, not meetings booked for their own sake. The leading indicator is qualified AWS-sourced pipeline. The lagging indicator is closed-won revenue from customers who came in through the AWS field. Quota structure and targets are discussed in the interview process.

Die Montana Bausysteme AG ist als Schweizer Unternehmen der Tata Steel Nederland BV ein innovativer und etablierter Hersteller von Profilen für Metallfassaden, Verbunddecken und Metalldächer in Stahl und Aluminium. Nebst der Kundenzufriedenheit ist die Qualität der Produkte und Dienstleistungen das höchste Ziel.
Zur Verstärkung des deutschen Marktes suchen wir im exklusiven Mandatsauftrag per sofort oder nach Vereinbarung eine verkaufsstarke Persönlichkeit, die Norddeutschland zu ihrem Markt macht.
**Dein Gebiet. Deine Kunden. Dein Erfolg.**
Du übernimmst die Verantwortung für das Verkaufsgebiet Norddeutschland und bist dort das Gesicht von Montana. Deinen bestehenden Kundenstamm betreust du persönlich und mit dem Anspruch, aus guten Geschäftsbeziehungen langfristige Partnerschaften zu machen. Gleichzeitig gehst du aktiv auf neue Kunden zu und erschliesst zusätzliche Marktpotenziale.

Als kompetenter Ansprechpartner begleitest du Architekten, Bauherren und Fachplaner bei ihren Projekten, berätst sie rund um die technischen Möglichkeiten und führst Projekte vom ersten Kontakt bis zum erfolgreichen Verkaufsabschluss.

Dein Verkaufsgebiet organisierst du weitgehend eigenständig: Du setzt Prioritäten, planst deine Kundenbesuche und behältst laufende Projekte sowie Verkaufschancen im Blick. Bei Offerten und administrativen Aufgaben unterstützt dich dein Team im Innendienst, während du dich auf den Markt und deine Kunden konzentrieren kannst.

Darüber hinaus repräsentierst du Montana bei Veranstaltungen und baust dein Netzwerk in der Region kontinuierlich aus
**Dein Profil**
Du bist Verkäufer aus Überzeugung, denkst unternehmerisch und verstehst es, technische Kompetenz mit einem guten Gespür für Menschen und Geschäftsmöglichkeiten zu verbinden.
* Bautechnische Ausbildung oder vergleichbarer technischer Hintergrund
* Erfahrung im technischen Aussendienst, idealerweise im Bauumfeld
* Sicherer Umgang mit Architekten, Planern und weiteren Entscheidungsträgern
* Freude an langfristiger Kundenbetreuung und aktiver Neukundenakquise
* Technisches Verständnis sowie ausgeprägtes Verkaufs- und Verhandlungsgeschick
* Selbstständige, strukturierte und unternehmerische Arbeitsweise
* Gewinnendes Auftreten, Kommunikationsstärke und hohe Kundenorientierung
* Wohnort idealerweise innerhalb des Verkaufsgebietes Norddeutschland
**Dein Gewinn**
Hier bekommst du nicht einfach eine Verkaufsregion, sondern deinen eigenen Markt. Du gestaltest deinen Arbeitsalltag weitgehend selbstständig, übernimmst echte Verantwortung und hast gleichzeitig einen starken Innendienst sowie ein etabliertes Unternehmen im Rücken. Dein Arbeitsplatz ist dein Homeoffice und vor allem dort, wo deine Kunden sind.

Dazu kommen fünf Wochen Ferien, moderne Arbeitsmittel, ein Firmenfahrzeug auch zur privaten Nutzung sowie ein attraktives Vergütungsmodell mit einer erfolgsabhängigen Vergütung. Kurze Entscheidungswege, eine umfassende Einarbeitung und viel Gestaltungsspielraum runden das Gesamtpaket ab.
